messages:
harper: hey all, i'm harper on growth, day 1. trying to spin up a small test VM in europe-west2 but hitting permissions errors. i've been told to impersonate a service account that owns the sandbox, but `gcloud auth print-access-token --impersonate-service-account` fails with PERMISSION_DENIED. who owns the impersonation bindings?

cloudinfra-bot: Welcome Harper! Tag @raj (infra) or @tori (platform). Onboarding doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/onboarding/cloud-access#gcp-impersonation

harper: error from CLI: ```
ERROR: (gcloud.auth.print-access-token) PERMISSION_DENIED: The caller does not have permission

Caller: harper@redwood.com
Target: serviceAccount:sbx-eu-runner@redwood-customer.iam.gserviceaccount.com
Required: iam.serviceAccounts.getAccessToken
```

raj: hey @harper. looks like you need `roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator` on that service account (or a group with that binding). We usually bind it to `devs-onboarding@redwood.com` for temp access. Did you request access via the onboarding checklist?

harper: i followed the checklist but didn't see a step for impersonation. i created ONBOARD-3315 with project id `redwood-growth-sbx-eu` and included the service account.

tori: adding context: for EU sandboxes we sometimes have an org policy that restricts who can be granted tokenCreator (domain restriction or approved groups only). If the org policy forbids adding new principals, infra will instead grant a short-lived delegated access via a per-user ephemeral role.

raj: can you run `gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-growth-sbx-eu --format=json` and paste whether `devs-onboarding@redwood.com` or your user appears? if you can't run it paste a screenshot.

harper: can't run it (403). screenshot attached to ONBOARD-3315. caller id: `{ "email": "harper@redwood.com", "sub": "1155..." }`

billing-bot: ONBOARD-3315 created and routed to infra. Note: if the project has no billing link, quota and certain operations will be blocked. Include billing account id if you expect to create VMs.

raj: thanks. infra will check two things: (1) whether the serviceAccountTokenCreator role can be granted under our org policies, (2) whether the project is linked to the shared billing account `PA-322`. If org policy blocks, we'll either create a short-lived service account for you or add you to the onboarding group for 48h.

harper: timeline? i just need a tiny n1-standard-1 for 30 minutes to smoke a script against europe-west2.

tori: typical SLA for these onboarding impersonation grants is same-day if it's just adding you to the onboarding group. If a policy exception is required it's longer (1-3 business days). I'll prioritize since it's a quick smoke test.

harper: sweet. if you can do a temp impersonation, i can test now. otherwise i'll queue and work in us-central1.

raj: prepping a short-lived grant. will DM creds for ephemeral SA session (least privilege) if policy allows. if not, i'll add you to `devs-onboarding@redwood.com` for 24 hours.

harper: thanks! ping me when done. also, is there a doc for how to request `iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator` for future hires?

tori: yes — internal doc under onboarding/gcp-roles has the template. we'll add a quick note to the checklist to avoid future confusion.

harper: appreciate it, thanks team :raised_hands:
